article.content_html:
Key Developments

On September 13, 2026, CBSNews.com released a video report titled "Good gourd! A visit to the pumpkin capital of the world." This broadcast specifically identified Morton, Illinois, as the global hub for pumpkins, referring to it as the "pumpkin capital of the world." The feature by a prominent news organization brings national and potentially international attention to the town's significant role in pumpkin production. The report's focus on Morton highlights the town's established reputation or emerging importance within the agricultural sector, particularly concerning gourds.

Key Takeaways

  • Morton, Illinois, was spotlighted by CBSNews.com on September 13, 2026, as the "pumpkin capital of the world."
  • The news segment underscores Morton's unique agricultural specialization and its contribution to the global pumpkin supply.
  • The report's title, "Good gourd! A visit to the pumpkin capital of the world," directly communicates its central theme.

Why It Matters

The designation by CBS News elevates Morton, Illinois, as a key player in the agricultural landscape, particularly for pumpkin cultivation. Such media coverage can enhance the town's profile, potentially boosting local tourism, economic development, and community pride. For consumers, understanding the origins of agricultural products like pumpkins can deepen appreciation for regional farming efforts and specialized production centers.
